Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Use the provenance path molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Require INNER JOIN to compound_structures to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Filter activities for standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_relation = '='. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5251'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
